title: Replace Field Contents
description: Error-prone rule — Replace Field Contents steps. They rewrite the field across the whole found set with no undo; a wrong found set silently corrupts many records.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Replace Field Contents mutates every record in the found set irreversibly.
rule.remediation: Verify the found set first; guard with a confirmation and error handling.
